steps.message:
All done. Here's a summary of what was built:

## Orchard — Premium Tech E-Commerce Store

### Output Files (`/app/output/`)
| File | Description |
|---|---|
| `index.html` | Homepage with ribbon banner, hero, product grid (6 tiles), entertainment tabs, footer |
| `store.html` | Store page with icon bar, latest products carousel, help/store difference carousels, accessories, audio, brand collab, experience, savings, quick links |
| `shop-laptops.html` | Laptop category page with sticky section nav, all models carousel, guides, ways to save, accessories, setup support, experience, special stores |
| `shop-tablets.html` | Tablet category page with same structure as laptops |
| `css/styles.css` | Shared stylesheet with carousel, tab, accordion, grid, and responsive styles |
| `js/main.js` | Carousel scroll controls, entertainment tab switching, mobile footer accordion |

### Key Features Implemented
- **Carousels** with prev/next arrow buttons on store & category pages
- **Entertainment tabs** (Streaming / Fitness / Gaming / Music) on homepage
- **Sticky horizontal section nav** on laptops & tablets pages with anchor smooth-scroll
- **Footer accordion** for mobile (collapses/expands on click under 768px)
- **Pricing accuracy** — all prices match `source_brief.md` exactly
- **Full inter-page navigation** — all links between homepage, store, laptops, tablets work
- **Responsive design** — mobile-friendly grid, carousels, and navigation
- **RemixIcon** icon library integrated via CDN
- **No build step** — all pages open directly in a browser
